# SATELLITE VIEW [italic]Real pictures of {colony}, from orbit. Pictures update once a cycle, so any people you see in them have moved on. Probably.[/italic]
## WHAT YOU CAN SEE - [bold]The processor.[/bold] The biggest thing on the colony. Easy to spot. Hard to miss. Impossible to get rid of. - [bold]The landing zone.[/bold] The flat bit with the lights. The burn marks are dropships. Most of them. - [bold]Colony blocks.[/bold] Housing, medical, the canteen and the administration building, which has the only working fountain on most colonies. - [bold]The perimeter.[/bold] Where the lights stop.
## WHAT YOU CANNOT SEE - Anything under a roof. VectorQuest satellites cannot see through roofs, despite rumours, and despite one Company contract that asked if they could. - Garrison positions. These are blurred at the request of the United States Colonial Marine Corps. - Company research sites. These are blurred at the request of nobody. They were blurred when the picture arrived.
## SPOTTED FROM ORBIT Users send us odd things they find in the satellite pictures. This cycle: a word written in stones outside a mining camp, which says HELLO, and a second word, written later, a little further out, which we have decided not to print.
